meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 运行本技能的编程 harness 会接管迁移:盘点受影响的组,把 .seed.md、旧 CLAUDE.md、Claude 自动记忆等遗留文件暂存或隔离,整理进共享 memory 目录并重建索引,最后给出源到目标的报告。NanoClaw 本体和运行中的组不会自动导入遗留文件。
howto.when: 当更新提示共享内存破坏性变更后,或某个组里仍有 .seed.md、旧 CLAUDE.md 等遗留记忆文件时运行;你说“migrate memory”、“legacy memory”或“切换后智能体什么都忘了”也会触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个组的遗留记忆迁移到共享 memory 目录。
say.note: 会先盘点并请你确认再移动文件。

say.text: 检查还有哪些组存在 .seed.md 或旧 CLAUDE.md 需要迁移。
say.note: 列出受影响的组与冲突、符号链接状态。

say.text: 切换后智能体什么都忘了,帮我看看遗留记忆。
say.note: 进入迁移流程,停组并暂存遗留文件。

howto.what_en: The coding harness running this skill handles the migration: it inventories affected groups, stages or quarantines legacy files (e.g. .seed.md), files them into the shared memory tree, and reports source-to-destination. The NanoClaw host and running group never import legacy files.
howto.when_en: Runs after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, old CLAUDE.md, or Claude auto-memory; also triggers on "migrate memory" or "legacy memory".

say_en.text: Migrate this group's legacy memory into the shared memory tree.
say_en.note: It inventories first and asks for approval before moving files.

say_en.text: Check which groups still have .seed.md or old CLAUDE.md to migrate.
say_en.note: Lists affected groups plus collision and symlink status.

say_en.text: The agent forgot everything after the switch - check the legacy memory.
say_en.note: Starts migration: stops the group and stages legacy files.
